text: Few people ever experience life on board an offshore vessel.
Its systems work out of sight, below the waterline and behind the bridge door.
Offshore, a vessel holds its station with every system on board working as one.
Behind every thruster stands the power plant that drives it.
Not everyone can step on board.
So we bring the vessel to you.
An exclusive Sinor Marine initiative.

text.say: Version one point zero brings the power plant on board, with the systems that keep the DP running.
text.show: Version 1.0 brings the power plant on board, with the systems that keep the DP running.

title: Vessel Systems Simulator 1.0
subtitle: Power, positioning and sensors in one live vessel

text.say: This is version one point zero of the Sinor Marine Vessel Systems Simulator.
text.show: This is version 1.0 of the Sinor Marine Vessel Systems Simulator.

text: Power, position, and sensors now share one live model of the vessel.

title: Power Management System
subtitle: Live single line diagram · generators · synchronising
text: The power management system shows the whole plant on a live single line diagram.
Start a standby generator, and the PMS refuses to close it onto a live bus until it is synchronised.

title: Blackout and recovery
subtitle: Generator trip · standby start · drive restart

text.say: With one generator per side, trip G one, and switchboard A goes dark.
text.show: With one generator per side, trip G1, and switchboard A goes dark.

text: Within seconds, the PMS closes the standby set onto the dead bus, and restarts the thruster drives one by one.

title: DP UPS
subtitle: No-break power for the DP controllers and sensors

text.say: Lose the four hundred and forty volt board, and DP UPS A carries its DP equipment from the battery, with no break.
text.show: Lose the 440 V board, and DP UPS A carries its DP equipment from the battery, with no break.

text: Its remaining battery time is shown live.

title: Wind sensors
subtitle: Measured wind versus the real wind
text: The wind sensors give the DP its wind feed-forward.
Fail both in a gusty wind, and the feed-forward drops out, while the real wind keeps pushing the vessel.

title: Heading reference voting
subtitle: Three gyrocompasses · automatic rejection
text: Three gyrocompasses vote on the heading.
When one slowly drifts away, it is rejected, and the DP keeps the true heading.

title: Exhibition demo
subtitle: Every training scenario, looping on its own
text: For exhibitions, one button starts a guided demonstration.
It runs every scenario on its own, with captions, and loops until you press exit.

title: On the big screen, fully offline
subtitle: Android TV remote control · Windows PC · pen drive
text: On a television, the whole simulator is driven with the remote control.
And it is packaged to run fully offline, on a Windows PC or an Android TV, straight from a pen drive.

title: Understand the systems. Work more efficiently.
subtitle: An exclusive Sinor Marine initiative
text: When people understand the systems, they operate them better, and the whole vessel works more efficiently.
Step aboard, with Sinor Marine.
Sinor Marine.
We bring the vessel to you.
